description: Phase 4 (PLAN.md): design asks phrased the way they arrive, each with the recipes a person would hand-pick for it. The intent ranker passes a case when one of `expect` is in its top 3. Written before recipes/web/intents.json. A case that misses (the shelf lacks it, or the ranker cannot reach it) keeps its expectation and gains a `gap` saying why; the test then asserts it still misses, so a fix shows up. Never edit `expect` to make a miss pass.
